nodes.label: Planned: Proton workspace dock
nodes.description: Target desktop hub retains search while composing live widgets in one dock.

nodes.label: Design: one continuous glass dock
nodes.description: App, information and system widgets share one outer shell rather than separate capsules.

nodes.label: Design: reuse Proton Search engine
nodes.description: Existing indexing, query, content extraction and Windows launching are retained.

nodes.label: Design: adaptive widget information density
nodes.description: Widgets share profile-level height and bounded adaptive widths; wider sizes expose richer content.

nodes.label: Planned: Work Home Presentation compositions
nodes.description: Profiles replace visible layout and privacy; switching does not grant execution authority.

nodes.label: Planned: proton-domain
nodes.description: Typed IDs, actions, widget/profile models and errors, without native handles or rendering.

nodes.label: Planned: proton-storage
nodes.description: Paths, schema ledger, transactions and backup/import boundaries.

nodes.label: Planned: proton-search service
nodes.description: Prefix routing and generation-aware fast/slow provider composition separate from dock state.

nodes.label: Planned: proton-platform-windows
nodes.description: HWND/COM/WinRT adapters own AppBar, tasks, audio, power and hotkeys.

nodes.label: Planned: proton-widgets registry
nodes.description: Definitions, instances, constraints, declarative trees and shared subscriptions.

nodes.label: Planned: proton-dock UI boundary
nodes.description: Composition, input, panels, accessibility and monitor windows exclude blocking index/model/network work.

nodes.label: Planned: proton-agent-runner
nodes.description: Durable jobs, scoped approvals and provider execution state are independent of direct UI ownership.

nodes.label: Planned: proton-recovery
nodes.description: Heartbeat, restore journal and safe startup remain independent of plugins and main databases.

nodes.label: Design: generation-tagged incremental search
nodes.description: Fast metadata batch precedes bounded slower content/OCR batches; stale generations are discarded.

nodes.label: Design: shared provider snapshots
nodes.description: Coalesced state subscriptions avoid separate COM polling for every widget instance.

nodes.label: Planned: authenticated named-pipe IPC
nodes.description: Current-user/session DACL, caller checks and bounded versioned envelopes; JSON origin is not identity proof.

nodes.label: Planned: personal index credential separation
nodes.description: Personal state is retained, indexes are rebuildable, secrets use Windows credential storage.

nodes.label: Rationale: keep blocking work off UI thread
nodes.description: Explicit owning threads/apartments and bounded background work prevent providers freezing dock input.

nodes.label: Baseline: Rust and windows-rs
nodes.description: The proposed stack preserves the existing native Rust Windows integration.

nodes.label: Baseline: SQLite FTS5 search
nodes.description: rusqlite bundled SQLite and FTS5 plus existing notify remain the proposed search/storage baseline.

nodes.label: Design: Slint renderer candidate
nodes.description: Planning proposed Slint first, with native feasibility and resource measurements before renderer lock.

nodes.label: Planned evaluation: Tauri fallback
nodes.description: Identical Tauri prototype is a measured fallback, not a second permanent UI.

nodes.label: Planned gate: renderer SDK licensing
nodes.description: Slint licensing and public API exposure need clarification before renderer/SDK lock.

nodes.label: Planned: Wasmtime widget worker
nodes.description: Later executable extensions require bounded resources and no ambient WASI network/filesystem access.

nodes.label: Design: default Explorer coexistence
nodes.description: Explorer remains running; dock negotiates work area cooperatively with other bars.

nodes.label: Planned gate: reversible taskbar hiding
nodes.description: Explicit optional compatibility appearance requires recovery, tested builds and native tray access; not shell replacement.

nodes.label: Design: AppBar work-area negotiation
nodes.description: SHAppBarMessage NEW QUERYPOS SETPOS REMOVE defines cooperative work-area lifecycle.

nodes.label: Planned: ownership-aware restore journal
nodes.description: Persist changed OS before-state with owner/session/generation and expiry before mutation.

nodes.label: Planned: independent recovery watchdog
nodes.description: Watchdog restores without plugins/main databases; standalone restore remains a required gate.

nodes.label: Planned gate: native tray continuity
nodes.description: Replacement claims require accessible tray, language/input, network and security workflows.

nodes.label: Planned: widget definition contract
nodes.description: Package identity, API version, size constraints, configuration schema, permissions and templates.

nodes.label: Design: per-placement widget instance
nodes.description: Multiple placements/configurations of a definition have independent instance identity.

nodes.label: Design: shared widget provider
nodes.description: Shared host data services are distinct from widget instances and rendered views.

nodes.label: Planned: validated renderer-neutral view DSL
nodes.description: Host renders bounded declarative trees and accessibility; community packages do not gain raw scripts or Slint APIs.

nodes.label: Planned: typed brokered widget actions
nodes.description: Actions refer to approved host operations rather than raw command strings or arbitrary URLs.

nodes.label: Planned: widget trust tiers
nodes.description: Reviewed built-ins, declarative packages, later WASM and same-user native execution are distinct trust levels.

nodes.label: Planned: brokered live weather provider
nodes.description: Manual location, provider licensing/attribution, caching and stale/offline state are planned, not proven native functionality.

nodes.label: Planned: curated widget ecosystem
nodes.description: Schemas, validator, provenance/digests and rollback precede executable logic or marketplace/cloud scope.

nodes.label: Planned: deliberate Search to Run action
nodes.description: Ordinary search does not grant execution authority; explicit Run with agent creates a job.

nodes.label: Planned: durable agent job state
nodes.description: Persist run IDs, grants and outputs; interrupted restart never automatically replays writes.

nodes.label: Planned: execution-time scoped grants
nodes.description: Authenticated run/tool/resource binding, expiry and revocation remain independent of profile appearance.

nodes.label: Planned: single desktop-input lease
nodes.description: Only one computer-use job drives the desktop; yields to user input and never drives secure desktop/UAC.

nodes.label: Baseline: Hermes agent adapter seam
nodes.description: Existing ai.rs streaming callbacks/Hermes are reusable adapters, not a concurrent durable scheduler.

nodes.label: Baseline debt: global approvals and credentials
nodes.description: Fixed gateway fallback, CLI credential transfer and global approval inheritance need repair before concurrent/untrusted execution.

nodes.label: Rationale: preserve personal data during migration
nodes.description: Consistent backup and isolated imports retain personal artifacts instead of treating them as disposable indexes.

nodes.label: Planned: isolated preview identity
nodes.description: Separate install/data/startup identity protects original production state during migration.

nodes.label: Baseline debt: destructive uninstall
nodes.description: Baseline installer removed current AppData directory; preserve-data behavior is a release prerequisite.

nodes.label: Baseline: Win32 search controller
nodes.description: Baseline search main.rs is Win32/GDI with fast/slow phases; separate Slint settings is not the search renderer.

nodes.label: Baseline: selected-folder FTS indexer
nodes.description: Selected-folder crawling and bounded child document extraction are reused; no Everything/MFT parity claim.

nodes.label: Planned: native release acceptance gates
nodes.description: Search parity, restore behavior, data preservation and accessibility are release gates rather than HTML claims.

nodes.label: Planned targets: frame input resource budgets
nodes.description: Roadmap metrics are proposed goals needing hardware/corpus measurement, not achieved results.

nodes.label: Demo: browser widget library
nodes.description: widget-library.js provides original SVG symbols and semantic markup for HTML mockup.

nodes.label: Demo: browser profile layout controller
nodes.description: concept.js owns browser composition, profiles, gallery and local persistence.

nodes.label: Demo: sample interactive runtime
nodes.description: widget-runtime.js implements sample interactions without model/native filesystem effects.

nodes.label: Demo: widget polish stylesheet
nodes.description: widget-polish.css styles coordinated neutral glass mockup appearance.

nodes.label: Demo design: anchored reusable panel
nodes.description: One anchored panel toggles/dismisses and restores focus, separate from persisted layout.

nodes.label: Design evidence: Microsoft and upstream references
nodes.description: Source inventory distinguishes documented API facts, recommendations and baseline observations.
